activities.title: Evasion Gauntlet
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–10 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Evasion
- Secondary theme: Tracking
- Tags: Engagement, Footwork, Body Height

## Objective
Attack:
- Develop evasive footwork and acceleration.
Defense:
- Maintain spacing and lateral discipline.

## Setup
- 3 lines of defenders holding hands.
- Defenders move laterally only.

## Game Play
- Ball carrier attempts to break through.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Change of pace.
- Stay square.
Defense:
- Stay connected.
- Close space without reaching.

activities.title: Silly Buggers
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Creative Attack
- Secondary theme: Defensive Adaptation
- Tags: Engagement, Spatial Awareness

## Objective
- Encourage creativity and spatial awareness.

## Setup
- Small-sided field.
- Two teams.

## Game Play
- Ball may be passed or kicked in any direction.
- Ball carrier must remain stationary.
- Turnover on drop.
- Score in opponent’s end zone.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Move early into space.
- Communicate options.
Defense:
- Close space aggressively.
- Anticipate kicks.

activities.title: Knee Tag
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Evasion
- Secondary theme: Tracking
- Tags: Engagement, Agility, Tactical Thinking

## Objective
Evasion:
- Develop agility and spatial awareness.
- Encourage tactical freeing of teammates.
Defense:
- Improve tracking and decision-making when tagging.

## Setup
- 20m x 20m grid.
- One player starts as tagger.
- All others are evaders.

## Game Play
- First tag: player drops to one knee.
- Kneeling players can be freed by teammates.
- Second tag: player joins tagging team.
- Last evader wins.

## Performance Factors
- Quick change of direction.
- Awareness of free teammates.
- Taggers think strategically about who to target.

activities.title: Collect the Flags
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–10 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Evasion
- Secondary theme: Competition
- Tags: Engagement, Agility, Conditioning

## Objective
- Develop evasive movement under pressure.
- Encourage spatial awareness and competitiveness.

## Setup
- 20m x 20m grid.
- Each player wears a flag belt.

## Game Play
- 60-second rounds.
- Players collect as many flags as possible.
- Most flags wins.

## Performance Factors
- Protect own space.
- Attack blind spots.
- Change direction explosively.

activities.title: Ring Around the Rosie (Ball Reaction Game)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–10 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Reaction & Acceleration
- Secondary theme: Competition
- Tags: Engagement, Acceleration, Ball Awareness

## Objective
- Develop reaction speed and acceleration toward ball.

## Setup
- Cones in a circle with balls in center.
- One fewer ball than players.
- Players shuffle around outside.

## Game Play
- Coach calls “left” or “right.”
- Players shuffle accordingly.
- On “go,” players enter circle and grab ball.
- Player without ball is out and removes a ball.

## Performance Factors
- Stay light on feet.
- Quick reaction to cue.
- Explode into space.

progressions.content_markdown: Eliminated players become defenders in circle.

activities.title: Caterpillar Chase
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–10 minutes
- Game phases: defense
- Primary theme: Acceleration
- Secondary theme: Team Coordination
- Tags: Engagement, Conditioning

## Objective
- Develop acceleration and group movement coordination.

## Setup
- Players form a line holding hips.
- Group jogs forward.

## Game Play
- Last player sprints to front.
- Caterpillar attempts to evade rejoining runner.

## Performance Factors
- Communication.
- Quick acceleration.
- Spatial awareness.

activities.title: Balloon Ball
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–8 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Coordination
- Secondary theme: Communication
- Tags: Engagement, Tracking, Fun

## Objective
- Improve hand-eye coordination and communication.

## Setup
- Teams of 2–4.
- One or more balloons.

## Game Play
- Keep balloon(s) in air.
- Add additional balloons over time.

## Performance Factors
- Early communication.
- Move into space before balloon drops.

progressions.content_markdown: Assign balloon color to specific player.

activities.title: Telephone
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–8 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Communication
- Secondary theme: Team Cohesion
- Tags: Engagement, Culture

## Objective
- Develop loud, clear communication.
- Build team cohesion.

## Setup
- Team spread across width of field.

## Game Play
- One player calls instruction.
- Message must travel across field.
- Entire team performs action together.

## Performance Factors
- Clear voice.
- Confident communication.
- Team synchronization.

activities.title: Fetch a Friend Bronco
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Conditioning
- Secondary theme: Teamwork
- Tags: Engagement, Conditioning, Sprint

## Objective
- Develop repeat sprint ability.
- Build team accountability.

## Setup
- Cones at 20m, 40m, 60m.
- Teams of 4.
- One player at each cone and start line.

## Game Play
- Runner collects teammate at each cone.
- All hold hands returning.
- Cycle positions and repeat.

## Performance Factors
- Sprint form.
- Controlled deceleration.
- Team encouragement.

activities.title: Scrum ‘o War
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–8 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Contact Prep
- Tags: Activation, Body Position

## Objective
- Develop body height and leg drive for contact.

## Setup
- 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 over cone.

## Game Play
- Bind and drive opponent back.

## Performance Factors
- Flat back.
- Strong bind.
- Leg drive first.

activities.title: Macarena Push-Ups Circle
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 4–6 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Upper Body Activation
- Secondary theme: Core Stability
- Tags: Activation, Upper Body Prep

## Objective
- Prepare shoulders, core, and wrists for contact work.

## Setup
- Players in circle, push-up position.

## Game Play
- Perform Macarena arm sequence while holding plank/push-up.

## Performance Factors
- Stable hips.
- Controlled arm movement.
- Strong plank position.

activities.title: Pairs Kick-Off Catching
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–8 minutes
- Game phases: defense, restart, kick_aerial
- Primary theme: Aerial Activation
- Secondary theme: Communication
- Tags: Activation, Catching

## Objective
- Prepare players for aerial contests and communication.

## Setup
- Groups of 3.
- One thrower simulates kick.
- Two receivers attempt one-handed catch together.

## Game Play
- Receivers coordinate to secure ball with one hand each.

## Performance Factors
- Early call.
- Track ball flight.
- Soft hands.

activities.title: Ball Rip
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–8 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, breakdown
- Primary theme: Contact Activation
- Secondary theme: Ball Security
- Tags: Activation, Breakdown

## Objective
- Prepare players for breakdown contest and ball protection.

## Setup
- Pairs with one ball.

## Game Play
- Attacker protects ball.
- Defender attempts legal rip.
- Rotate every 30 seconds.

## Performance Factors
Attacker:
- Strong base.
- Ball tight to chest.
Defender:
- Target ball, not body.
- Legal grip and twist.

activities.title: Line Pass, Run
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–8 minutes
- Game phases: attack
- Primary theme: Ball Speed
- Tags: Skill, Passing

## Objective
- Develop catch-pass rhythm.

## Setup
- 6–7 players spaced 2m apart.

## Game Play
- Pass down line.
- Last player slaloms through.
- Repeat.

## Performance Factors
- Hands early.
- Quick release.

activities.title: Kick-Off Simulation
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 5–10 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, restart
- Primary theme: Restart Structure
- Secondary theme: Phase Defense
- Tags: Skill, Restart

## Objective
Defense:
- Organize quickly and defend first two phases.
Attack:
- Execute structured restart shape.

## Setup
- Kick from center.
- Receiving team has two phases to score past halfway.

## Performance Factors
Defense:
- Line integrity.
- Communication.
Attack:
- Early shape.
- Ball speed.

activities.title: Kicking Game
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–20 minutes
- Game phases: kick_aerial
- Primary theme: Contestable Kicking
- Secondary theme: Aerial Receiving
- Tags: Skill, Kicking

## Objective
- Develop kicking height and aerial catch confidence.

## Setup
- Two teams.
- Defined zones.

## Game Play
- Alternate kicking and receiving.
- Ball must travel 10m in air.
- Catch in air eliminates opponent.
- Grounded ball eliminates closest player.

## Performance Factors
Kicker:
- Height before distance.
Receiver:
- Fingers first.
- Shoulder turn.
- Protect landing.

activities.title: Passing Gauntlet
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack
- Primary theme: Ball Speed
- Secondary theme: Catch-Pass Flow
- Tags: Skill, Passing, Movement

## Objective
- Develop catch-pass flow while maintaining forward momentum.
- Improve passing accuracy at speed.

## Setup
- Two rows of 4–5 cones, 10m apart, forming a channel.
- One player on each cone.
- Balls at each cone on one side.
- Attacker starts at one end of channel.

## Game Play
- Attacker runs down channel.
- Receives pass from one side.
- Passes immediately to opposite side.
- Continues through entire channel.

## Performance Factors
- Catch early.
- Pass in front of receiver.
- Maintain running speed.
- Eyes up before pass.

activities.title: Y Reaction Drill
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–10 minutes
- Game phases: attack
- Primary theme: Change of Direction
- Secondary theme: Decision-Making
- Tags: Skill, Agility, Reaction

## Objective
- Develop reactive footwork and directional change.

## Setup
- Cones in Y shape (base, intersection, two endpoints).
- Coach or player at intersection.

## Game Play
- Attacker runs from base toward intersection.
- Coach indicates direction at last moment.
- Attacker plants and accelerates to chosen endpoint.

## Performance Factors
- Low body position.
- Quick plant and explode.
- Eyes up before decision.

activities.title: 2 Channel 2v1
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Fix & Pass
- Secondary theme: Defensive Commitment
- Tags: Skill, Channel Play, Decision

## Objective
Attack:
- Fix defender before passing.
- Use width and depth effectively.
Defense:
- Close space quickly.
- Commit at correct moment.

## Setup
- Two adjacent channels: 5m and 10m.
- Attackers start in 5m channel.
- Defender at end of 5m channel.

## Game Play
- 2 attackers attempt to beat defender in 5m channel.
- Defender must loop around cone before defending 10m channel.
- Attackers attempt to win 10m channel.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Attack defender’s inside shoulder.
- Late pass.
- Stay square.
Defense:
- Close space early.
- Commit decisively.

progressions.content_markdown: Add scoring incentive for wide finish.

activities.title: Breakout (1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Transition Attack
- Secondary theme: Defensive Recovery
- Tags: Skill, Chaos Start, Decision

## Objective
- Develop reaction and transition attack from static start.

## Setup
- 10m x 10m grid.
- Attack and defense start lying on backs in touch.

## Game Play
- Defense calls “go.”
- Both teams sprint into field.
- Attack has one attempt to score.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Quick organization.
- Attack space immediately.
- Communicate roles early.
Defense:
- Recover shape.
- Close space quickly.

activities.title: Side Step Progression
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 6–10 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Evasion Technique
- Secondary theme: Acceleration
- Tags: Skill, Footwork

## Objective
- Develop effective side-step and acceleration out of break.

## Setup
- Attacker at starting cone.
- Secondary cone 5m ahead.

## Game Play
- Attacker runs to 5m cone.
- Executes side-step, goose step, or change of direction.
- Accelerates through.

## Performance Factors
- Drop hips before step.
- Sell direction with shoulders.
- Explode after cut.

activities.title: L Hands
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack
- Primary theme: Passing Under Movement
- Secondary theme: Shape
- Tags: Skill, Passing, Structure

## Objective
- Develop catch-pass rhythm through directional change.

## Setup
- 6 cones in L shape, 5m apart.
- Players distributed along cones.

## Game Play
- Ball moves outside → inside through L.
- Players follow pass and join opposite line.

## Performance Factors
- Hands ready early.
- Communicate target.
- Maintain spacing.

progressions.content_markdown: Add passive defender in passing lane.

activities.title: Pick a Gap
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Gap Recognition
- Secondary theme: Defensive Alignment
- Tags: Skill, Decision, Channel

## Objective
Attack:
- Identify and exploit available gaps.
Defense:
- Communicate and fill space.

## Setup
- Tackle bags set to create 3–4 gaps.
- Defense has one fewer player than number of gaps.
- Attack starts with pass from scrum half.

## Game Play
- Each defender selects a gap to fill.
- Attack must move ball to hit open gap.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Early scan.
- Quick ball movement.
- Attack weak shoulder.
Defense:
- Communicate assignments.
- Close gap decisively.

activities.title: X Pattern Contact Drill
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Ball Speed Through Contact
- Secondary theme: Support & Ruck Entry
- Tags: Pattern, Shape, Contact

## Objective
- Develop ball movement through structured shape.
- Reinforce support lines and post-contact decision.

## Setup
- Cones in X pattern with one central cone.
- One defender with tackle shield at top point.
- Attackers at remaining 3 cones.
- Ball starts at central cone.

## Game Play
- Ball passes from center to one attacker.
- Center follows pass.
- Ball carrier carries into contact (shield).
- Support player clears or presents ball.
- Ball returned to center.
- Repeat opposite side.

## Performance Factors
- Pass in front.
- Support tight and early.
- Quick recycle.
- Reload shape immediately.

activities.title: Switch & Dummy Switch Pass (DSP)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack
- Primary theme: Backline Deception
- Secondary theme: Timing & Depth
- Tags: Pattern, Backline, Decision

## Objective
- Develop timing and deception in midfield.
- Improve communication between 9–10–12–13.

## Setup
- Attacking backline in structure.
- Scrum half initiates play and follows pass.

## Game Play
- Pass from scrum half to fly half.
- Fly half chooses:
  - Switch with inside center; or
  - Dummy switch → pass to outside center.
- Finish through designated scoring gates.

## Performance Factors
- Flat alignment.
- Sell switch with body language.
- Late pass.
- Communication between 10 & 12.

activities.title: Loop & Dummy Loop Pass (DLP)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Backline Shape
- Secondary theme: Support Lines
- Tags: Pattern, Backline, Timing

## Objective
- Develop loop timing and depth.
- Reinforce support angles.

## Setup
- Backline aligned in attack structure.
- Scrum half initiates play and follows pass.

## Game Play
- Pass to fly half.
- Fly half either:
  - Loops around inside center (10 → 12 → 10); or
  - Dummy loop → pass to outside center.
- Finish through scoring gates.

## Performance Factors
- Fly half accelerates around loop.
- Inside center holds defender.
- Outside center runs strong line.
- Depth maintained.

activities.title: L Attack
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Shape Under Pressure
- Secondary theme: Defensive Transition
- Tags: Pattern, Channel Attack

## Objective
Attack:
- Organize quickly and attack structured space.
Defense:
- Transition from pass to line speed.

## Setup
- 6 cones in L shape, 5m apart.
- Defense passes ball to attack to start.
- Defense immediately moves to defend.

## Game Play
- Attack must organize from turnover pass.
- One chance to score.
- Reset and rotate roles.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Quick shape call.
- Width and depth maintained.
- Attack weak shoulder.
Defense:
- Rapid line speed.
- Communication early.
- Stay square.

activities.title: Kick & Tackle
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, kick_aerial
- Primary theme: Kick Chase & First Contact
- Secondary theme: Open Field Tackle
- Tags: Contact, Tracking, Kick Chase

## Objective
Attack:
- Secure high ball and accelerate through space.
Defense:
- Track and execute effective open-field tackle.

## Setup
- 1 attacker and 1 defender, 10–15m apart.
- Gate positioned between them.
- Defender starts with ball.

## Game Play
- Defender kicks (drop kick or punt) to attacker.
- Attacker catches and attempts to run through gate.
- Defender chases and attempts tackle before gate.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Catch with early communication.
- Accelerate immediately after catch.
- Protect ball into contact.
Defense:
- Immediate chase.
- Track inside hip.
- Win body height.

activities.title: Tackle & Jackal or Counter
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Breakdown Contest
- Secondary theme: Tackle Technique
- Tags: Breakdown, Jackal, Counter-Ruck

## Objective
- Develop legal Jackal technique after tackle.
- Teach decision between Jackal and counter-ruck.

## Setup
- 1 defender with tackle bag.
- 1 attacker with ball and shield.
- Gate marked at breakdown entry.

## Game Play
- Defender tackles bag.
- Immediately regains feet and enters through gate.
- Attacker either:
  - Places ball on ground; or
  - Shields ball.
- Defender must:
  - Jackal if ball available; or
  - Counter-ruck if protected.

## Performance Factors
- Strong tackle entry.
- Fast reload to feet.
- Enter through gate.
- Clear decision-making.

activities.title: Jackal Support
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, breakdown
- Primary theme: Breakdown Support
- Secondary theme: Tackle Assist
- Tags: Breakdown, Team Defense

## Objective
- Develop coordinated tackle and Jackal roles.

## Setup
- 1 attacker.
- 2 defenders.

## Game Play
- Attacker carries into space.
- Defender 1 commits and tackles.
- Defender 2 assists tackle, releases, then Jackals.

## Performance Factors
- Clear role communication.
- First tackler secures body.
- Second defender fast to feet.
- Legal entry and strong base.

activities.title: Samoa (Micro Contact Game)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Contact Dominance
- Secondary theme: Close-Quarter Decision
- Tags: Breakdown, Contact, Micro-Space

## Objective
Attack:
- Complete pass under heavy pressure.
- Fight for ground.
Defense:
- Drive attacker backward.
- Disrupt ball movement.

## Setup
- 5m x 5m grid.
- 2 attackers with ball.
- 2 defenders with crash pads.

## Game Play
- Attack must complete pass and ground ball to score.
- Defense applies pressure and attempts to push into touch.
- Turnover and switch roles on drop or touch.

## Performance Factors
- Low body height.
- Leg drive through contact.
- Strong ball presentation.
- Defense wins height and space.

activities.title: Tackle Line Drill (Contact Progression)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 15–20 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, breakdown
- Primary theme: Multi-Phase Contact
- Secondary theme: Reaction & Discipline
- Tags: Contact, Phase Play, Organization

## Objective
Attack:
- Support through contact and recycle quickly.
- React quickly to penalties.
Defense:
- Track ball.
- Tackle effectively.
- Reset line quickly.

## Setup
- One attacking line.
- One defensive line facing each other.
- Ball starts in attacking line.

## Game Play
- Attack passes ball down line while stationary.
- Defense tracks ball.
- Coach calls “go.”
- Ball carrier attacks with 2 nearest players supporting.
- Defense tackles.
- Attack rucks and passes ball back to line.
- Random whistle indicates penalty.
- Teams react:
  - Defense back 10m.
  - Attack reorganizes quickly.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Quick support.
- Ball speed from breakdown.
- Identify space on penalty.
Defense:
- Close space early.
- Win tackle height.
- Fast reset on whistle.

activities.title: V2A Game
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense
- Primary theme: Defense Structure
- Secondary theme: Attack Space
- Tags: Positioning, Communication

## Objective
- Demonstrate importance of defensive alignment.

## Setup
- Cones in V shape for defenders.
- Defenders restricted to channel.

## Game Play
- Attack tap and attack space.
- Rotate defenders.

### Scoring
- Try = 1
- Touch = 1

## Performance Factors
Defense:
- Lateral movement.
- Space denial.
Attack:
- Ball speed.
- Attack weak shoulder.

activities.title: Fall in Line
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 15–20 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Structured Play
- Tags: Lane Discipline, Line Speed

## Objective
- Provide controlled game-like environment.

## Setup
- Field divided into 5m lanes.
- Players stay in lane.

## Game Play
- Kick-off or tap start.
- Defender back 5m after touch/tackle.
- Turnover on error.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Width and depth.
- Ball speed.
- Go forward.
Defense:
- Line speed.
- Stay in lane.
- Close space.

activities.title: Rapid Attack
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Ball Speed & Reset
- Secondary theme: Conditioning
- Tags: Constraint Game, Tempo, Attack

## Objective
Attack:
- Score repeatedly under time pressure.
- Reset shape quickly after contact.
Defense:
- Organize rapidly.
- Close space early.

## Setup
- Small-sided field.
- One attacking team, one defending team.

## Game Play
- 60-second attacking rounds.
- Attack attempts to score as many times as possible.
- On touch/tackle, attack immediately retreats to start line and re-attacks.
- Defense resets each rep.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Quick retreat and reload.
- Width and depth maintained.
- Ball moved before contact.
Defense:
- Rapid organization.
- Line speed under fatigue.

activities.title: Channel Pressure Game (2 Channel Constraint)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Fix & Finish
- Secondary theme: Defensive Commitment
- Tags: Constraint Game, Channel Play

## Objective
Attack:
- Manipulate defender across multiple channels.
Defense:
- Recover and close space quickly.

## Setup
- Two adjacent channels (5m and 10m).
- 2 attackers.
- 1 defender.

## Game Play
- Attack first engages defender in 5m channel.
- Defender must loop around cone before defending second channel.
- Attack attempts to win both channels sequentially.

### Constraint
- Attack must commit defender before passing.
- Score only if both channels are beaten.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Late decision.
- Square alignment.
- Support inside and outside.
Defense:
- Fast transition.
- Decisive commitment.

progressions.content_markdown: Add second defender in second channel.

activities.title: Breakout Chaos Game
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Transition Attack
- Secondary theme: Defensive Recovery
- Tags: Constraint Game, Chaos, Reaction

## Objective
- Develop immediate organization from disorganized start.

## Setup
- 10m x 10m grid.
- Attack and defense begin lying on backs in touch.

## Game Play
- Defense calls “go.”
- Both teams sprint into field.
- Attack has one attempt to score.

### Constraint
- Single scoring opportunity.
- No reset phases.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Early communication.
- Immediate role clarity.
- Attack weak shoulder.
Defense:
- Recover line quickly.
- Close space early.
- Stay square under chaos.

activities.title: 3v2 Continuous Overload
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 12–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Exploit Space
- Secondary theme: Support Lines
- Tags: 7s, Overload, Transition

## Objective
Attack:
- Convert 3v2 advantage consistently.
- Maintain width and depth under speed.
Defense:
- Delay and force sideline.
- Communicate inside-out coverage.

## Setup
- 15m wide channel, 20–25m long.
- 3 attackers vs 2 defenders.
- Ball starts with central attacker.

## Game Play
- Attack attempts to score.
- On score or turnover, immediate new 3 attackers enter from opposite side.
- Defenders stay for 2–3 reps before rotating.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Fix defender before pass.
- Attack weak shoulder.
- Inside support always alive.
Defense:
- First defender commits.
- Second defender tracks inside threat.
- Communicate early.

activities.title: 4-Phase Score or Turnover
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 15–20 minutes
- Game phases: multi_phase
- Primary theme: Multi-Phase Attack
- Secondary theme: Ruck Speed
- Tags: 7s, Phase Play, Conditioning

## Objective
- Maintain ball speed through 4 phases.
- Preserve width under fatigue.

## Setup
- Half-field.
- 5 attackers vs 4 defenders.
- Coach counts phases aloud.

## Game Play
- Attack must score within 4 phases.
- If ball slower than 3 seconds at ruck → automatic turnover.
- If 4 phases completed without score → turnover.

## Performance Factors
Attack:
- Clean within 2 seconds.
- Immediate reload to width.
- Forward momentum each phase.
Defense:
- Line speed every phase.
- Tackle → bounce → rejoin.

activities.title: Tackle → Reload Line Speed
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Defensive Reload
- Secondary theme: Line Speed
- Tags: 7s, Defense, Conditioning

## Objective
- Develop immediate reload after tackle.
- Maintain line integrity under fatigue.

## Setup
- 4 defenders vs 3 attackers.
- 20m channel.

## Game Play
- Attack runs phase.
- Defender who makes tackle must:
  - Bounce to feet.
  - Rejoin defensive line.
- Play continues for 3 phases.

## Performance Factors
- First defender wins height.
- Immediate reload.
- Line moves together.

activities.title: 3v2 Scramble Defense
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 12–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Transition Defense
- Secondary theme: Communication
- Tags: 7s, Scramble, Chaos

## Objective
Defense:
- Recover shape under broken play.
- Protect inside channel first.
Attack:
- Exploit numerical advantage quickly.

## Setup
- 3 attackers start with ball.
- 2 defenders positioned staggered.
- 20m x 20m grid.

## Game Play
- Attack begins unstructured.
- Defense must communicate and recover.
- If defense forces error or touch → win.

## Performance Factors
Defense:
- Protect inside shoulder.
- Delay, don’t dive.
- Talk constantly.
Attack:
- Ball before contact.
- Attack weak edge.

progressions.content_markdown: Add time limit (10 seconds to score).

activities.title: Clean & Pass (2-Second Ruck)
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 8–12 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, breakdown
- Primary theme: Ruck Speed
- Secondary theme: Decision-Making
- Tags: 7s, Breakdown Speed

## Objective
- Achieve sub-2-second ball at breakdown.
- Reinforce 1-man clean efficiency.

## Setup
- 3 attackers vs 2 defenders.
- Breakdown zone marked.

## Game Play
- Ball carrier enters contact.
- 1 cleaner clears defender.
- Scrum half must pass within 2 seconds.
- Coach counts aloud.

## Performance Factors
- Clean through gate.
- Low body height.
- Immediate pass from base.

activities.title: Transition Launch Game
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 12–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, defense, transition
- Primary theme: Turnover Attack
- Secondary theme: Awareness
- Tags: 7s, Transition, Counter

## Objective
- Attack immediately from turnover.
- Recognize unbalanced defense.

## Setup
- 5v5 half-field.
- Coach randomly calls “turnover.”

## Game Play
- On turnover call, possession switches immediately.
- New attacking team must exploit transition within 2 phases.

## Performance Factors
- Quick scan.
- Immediate width.
- Attack space before defense sets.

progressions.content_markdown: Add bonus point for first-phase score.

activities.title: Wide-to-Wide Fatigue Game
activities.content_markdown:
## Metadata
- Recommended duration: 10–15 minutes
- Game phases: attack, transition
- Primary theme: Width Under Fatigue
- Secondary theme: Support Lines
- Tags: 7s, Conditioning, Ball Speed

## Objective
- Maintain attacking width late in sequence.
- Support inside and outside continuously.

## Setup
- Full width, 30–40m length.
- 5v5.

## Game Play
- Attack must move ball touchline to touchline before scoring.
- If ball goes to ground → turnover.
- 45-second rounds.

## Performance Factors
- Quick hands.
- Depth maintained.
- Communicate reload shape.
